arms.first_slot_is_sentinel: skip first call, total starts at 0
arms.otherwise: clamped = min(total, cap); scale = dividend // cap; return (scale * clamped mod 2**64, clamped)

sentinel_body: endbr64; xor eax,eax; ret (7 bytes: returns 0, so skipping it contributes 0)
unknowns: identities of the two + 0x68 virtual functions (by contract only)
meanings of the + 0xa68 dividend and + 0xa70 cap fields beyond their offsets
null-subobject behavior (unguarded in-window; model assumes non-null)
